newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain set to sign electric sector protocol in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Spain set to sign electric sector protocol in Nov.

text.p: The Industry Ministry and Spanish electricity firms will sign in November a protocol for a new set of regulations governing the sector, Industry Minister Josep Pique told a parliamentary committee on Wednesday.
The protocol will include an initial agreement on electricity tariffs for 1997.

"The new (electricity) set-up is being negotiated with the companies and the government wants this to be reflected in the signing of a protocol between the Industry Ministry and the electricity firms during November," Pique said.

The new legal framework governing the sector could be presented to parliament in the first half of 1997 and be put into initial practice in the second half of the year. It would become definitively effective from January 1 1998, Pique said.
